assessments.title: Written examination
assessments.description: Written examination on Tuesday, 20 October 2026 from 14:00 to 17:00 (subscribed timetable rechecked 21 September). Grading rules checked 21 September: three hours, maximum 30 examination points; calculators and books are not allowed. Three optional mini-exams can each award up to two bonus points, with at most six bonus points added to the exam. Grade thresholds for the resulting total: A at least 25; B 22 to below 25; C 20 to below 22; D 17 to below 20; E 15 to below 17. No personal bonus, score or result is recorded.
